simple.meaning: תְּכוּנָה (tᵉkûwnâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “adjustment , i.e. structure ; by implication, equipage.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: adjustment , i.e. structure ; by implication, equipage
definitions.full: H8498. tekunah תְּכוּנָה noun feminine arrangement, preparation, fixed place ; — 1 arrangement, disposition תְּכוּנָתוֺ Ezek 43:11 , i.e. the arrangement of the house (strike out Co with ᵐ5 Manuscripts) 2 preparation , לַתְּכוּנָה קֶצֶה וְאֵין Nahum 2:10 and no end to the preparation (i.e. things prepared, supply, store). 3 fixed place , i.e. dwelling-place, of God (= מָכוֺן ) תְּכוּנָתוֺ Job 23:3 .

occurrences.englishText: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, and its fashion, and its exits, and its entrances, and all its forms, and all its ordinances, and all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight; that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
